description: tunnels des lignes ferroviaires is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Société nationale des Chemins de Fer Luxembourgeois. This database contains the tunnels of the railway lines of the Luxembourg rail network as defined by the CFL as Infrastructure Manager. The data are available in ESRI Shape format. Data are projected in the national coordinate system LUREF (EPSG:2169). The data is also available in KML format. Coverage: Société nationale des Chemins de Fer Luxembourgeois. The portal shows the English title as "railway tunnels" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Société nationale des Chemins de Fer Luxembourgeois. Its keywords include reseau-ferroviaire, railway-network, lignes-ferrees, gestionnaire-infrastructure-ferr, mobility, tunnels. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-by-sa. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
